facts.text: As a work college serving 108 central Appalachian counties, Alice Lloyd College guarantees tuition coverage for students from its service area, requiring full-time students to work at least 160 hours per semester.

sources.title: U.S. News Ranks Alice Lloyd #1
sources.quote: The program requires every full-time student to work a minimum of 160 hours per semester, and the students are paid the prevailing minimum wage rate.
